tool.name: BioNym resolve
tool.description: resolve a gene identifier into a confidence-scored knowledge graph

credentials.name: typesafe_jev
credentials.label: JEV judge (TypeSafe systemone)
credentials.description: API credentials for the typed-question judge. Get a key at https://console.typesafe.ai/keys

variable.name: base_url
variable.label: Judge base URL
variable.description: Alternate /v1/systemone endpoint (e.g. CLM/Laya). Leave empty for TypeSafe.

variable.name: model
variable.label: Judge model
variable.description: Judge model string. Leave empty for the endpoint default.

credentials.name: litellm_llm
credentials.label: LLM endpoint (OpenAI-compatible)
credentials.description: Optional LLM used for claim proposals and summaries. Any OpenAI-compatible endpoint (LiteLLM proxy, OpenRouter, Ollama).

variable.name: base_url
variable.label: LLM base URL
variable.description: Endpoint base URL, e.g. your LiteLLM proxy /v1

variable.name: model
variable.label: LLM model
variable.description: Model string for your endpoint. Only needed for a custom endpoint — on an admin-configured LiteLLM proxy, pick per-run in the tool form instead.

secret.name: api_key
secret.label: LLM API key
secret.description: API key for the OpenAI-compatible endpoint

credentials.name: ncbi
credentials.label: NCBI API key
credentials.description: Optional — raises the NCBI rate limit from 3/s to 10/s.

credentials.name: veupathdb
credentials.label: VEuPathDB API key
credentials.description: Optional — registered-user key enables direct VEuPathDB lookups (release 71+); without it resolution falls back to NCBI.

tool.command: ## per-job cache keeps API/JEV responses across retries within this job export BIONYM_CACHE_DIR="\$PWD/.bionym_cache" && export BIONYM_PROPOSAL_MIN_SCORE=$adv.proposal_min_score && export BIONYM_PROPOSAL_CONCURRENCY=$adv.proposal_concurrency && #if $adv.llm_model: export LLM_MODEL="$adv.llm_model.fields.model_id" && #end if bionym resolve '$identifier' --out graph.json --depth $depth --min-confidence $min_confidence $propose #if str($test_mode) == 'true': --mock-jev --mock-llm #end if #if $summarize: --summarize #end if #if $report_output: --report #end if

param.name: identifier
param.label: Gene identifier
param.help: NCBI GeneID, symbol, VEuPathDB locus tag, UniProt accession, Ensembl ID — any species

param.name: depth
param.label: Pipeline depth
param.help: How far the JEV-judged evidence pipeline runs. Depth 6 adds cross-assembly presence: which related assemblies NCBI annotates the gene in, plus JEV-judged presence where unannotated. All stages use JEV + public APIs only — the LLM is only used by the proposal/summary passes below.

param.name: min_confidence
param.label: Minimum edge confidence
param.help: Drop edges (and orphan nodes) below this confidence after resolution

param.name: propose
param.label: LLM proposal passes
param.help: One post-pipeline pass: JEV triages dataset/publication nodes, the LLM proposes claims on the top candidates, JEV verifies each. Requires LLM credentials; without them this is a no-op.

param.name: summarize
param.label: Write gene summary
param.help: Also produce a JEV-verified summary into graph metadata (needs LLM + JEV)

param.name: report_output
param.label: HTML report
param.help: Also emit a self-contained HTML report

param.name: llm_model
param.label: LLM model
param.help: Model for proposal/summary passes — from the same genai_models table as the LLM Hub tool

param.name: proposal_min_score
param.label: Proposal triage score
param.help: JEV score a dataset/publication needs before the LLM spends a call on it

tool.help:
**BioNym** resolves a gene identifier — any species — into a knowledge graph where every edge carries a JEV confidence score and evidence provenance.
.. class:: infomark
**Credentials.** Before first run, set your TypeSafe (JEV judge) API key under *User → Preferences → Credentials Management*. NCBI, VEuPathDB, and LLM credentials are optional; without an LLM key the proposal and summary passes are skipped. Admins may alternatively configure a LiteLLM proxy at the job destination, matching the LLM Hub tool's setup.
**Outputs**
- *graph* — the full knowledge graph as JSON (nodes, edges, per-edge confidence + evidence, per-stage token usage in ``metadata``) - *report* — optional self-contained HTML report
**Depth** selects how many pipeline stages run: S0 classify → S1 resolve → S2 assemblies → S3 orthologs → S4 annotation → S5 expression → S6 cross-assembly presence (``annotated_in`` edges from NCBI's gene report, JEV-judged presence for unannotated related assemblies). The optional **proposal pass** runs once afterwards over dataset/publication nodes (LLM-proposed, JEV-verified claims), and **summary** adds a JEV-verified gene summary to the graph metadata.
